name: hcapp_addEditUser
description: Creates or updates a Hasher record. Dual-mode: when @deviceId is blank/null it operates as a new-user creation flow (first app launch, no device record exists); when @deviceId is provided it performs an edit against an existing device-authenticated user. The access token is validated against DeviceSecret + targetUserId (not just DeviceSecret). Returns no direct confirmation — delegates to syncUserData, syncEventAdminData, or syncKennelAdminData depending on context.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Device UUID as a string. When blank or null, triggers new-user creation mode. Otherwise resolves the calling user from HC.Device.
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(100) instead of UNIQUEIDENTIFIER — same issue as hcapp_approveLogin.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Caller's userId. Default null-UUID. In normal flow this is overwritten from HC.Device lookup; in new-user mode (@deviceId blank) stays as null-UUID and the local variable remains '00000000...' to signal new-user path.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth token. Validated against DeviceSecret + UPPER(@targetUserId) — token is bound to the specific target user being edited.

parameters.name: hcVersion
parameters.description: App version. Used only in ErrorLog inserts, not stored on Hasher.

parameters.name: hashersUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync cursor passed to child sync SP.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync cursor passed to child sync SP.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync cursor passed to child sync SP.

parameters.name: targetUserId
parameters.description: User to create or edit. Default null-UUID triggers insert mode. On insert, a new UUID is generated and this parameter is replaced.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address. Empty string normalised to NULL. Duplicate email check performed — returns errorType=10005 if duplicate.

parameters.name: firstName
parameters.description: Empty string normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: lastName
parameters.description: Empty string normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: hashName
parameters.description: Empty string normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: photo
parameters.description: Empty string normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: includeInGlobalHashDirectory
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: preferences
parameters.description: Bitfield. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: If provided, new user is added to this event's HasherEventMap. Also controls which sync SP is called on completion.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: If provided, new user may be added to this kennel (controlled by @followKennelOnAddNewUser). Also controls which sync SP is called.

parameters.name: historicalTotalRunCount
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: historicalPackRunCount
parameters.description: Deprecated Nov 2021. Accepted but never used. Dead parameter.

parameters.name: historicalHaringCount
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: historicalCountIsEstimate
parameters.description: Flag whether historical counts are estimates.

parameters.name: followKennelOnAddNewUser
parameters.description: When non-zero, a new HasherKennelMap record is created for the new user at @kennelId.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Used to detect if user is in the US for miles/km preference default.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Used to detect if user is in the US for miles/km preference default.

parameters.name: nameDisplayPreference
parameters.description: Sentinel: <= 0 normalised to NULL.

rowsets.name: NullUserError
rowsets.description: When userId resolved to NULL (device lookup returned nothing). errorType=2.

rowsets.name: AuthError
rowsets.description: Token validation failure. errorType=1 (non-standard — should be 3).

rowsets.name: TargetUserNotFoundError
rowsets.description: targetUserId provided but not in HC.Hasher. errorType=5.

rowsets.name: DuplicateEmailError
rowsets.description: Email already in use by another Hasher. errorType=10005 — non-standard, well outside the defined range.

rowsets.name: NewUserProfile
rowsets.description: Only returned when @userId = null-UUID (new-user creation mode, no device record). Returns the newly created hasher record directly rather than delegating to a sync SP.

columns.name: qrSecretCode
columns.description: QR_secret_code — returned as nvarchar not UNIQUEIDENTIFIER.

columns.name: preferences
columns.description: Cast to nvarchar — string representation of the INT bitfield.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.Hasher — on new user creation
INSERT HC.LaunchAndLogin — on new user creation
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap — if @eventId provided and new user
INSERT HC.HasherKennelMap — if @kennelId provided, new user, and @followKennelOnAddNewUser != 0
UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap — if @kennelId provided and historical counts specified on edit
EXEC hcapp_syncUserData / hcapp_syncEventAdminData / hcapp_syncKennelAdminData — depending on context

codeSmells.detail: Same issue as hcapp_approveLogin. Forces implicit conversion against Device.id.

codeSmells.issue: errorType=10005 for duplicate email — far outside defined range
codeSmells.detail: errorType values 1-5 are defined. 10005 is an ad-hoc application-level code with no HC standard definition.
Marked as 'Deprecated: Nov 2021' in the parameter comment. Accepted but never read or used.

codeSmells.issue: Multiple parameter type mismatches vs Hasher columns
codeSmells.detail: @firstName, @lastName, @hashName NVARCHAR(100) vs Hasher NVARCHAR(250). @photo NVARCHAR(500) vs Hasher NVARCHAR(1000). Silent truncation possible.

codeSmells.issue: No authorization check when editing another user's record
codeSmells.detail: When @targetUserId != @userId, no check is made whether the caller has admin rights to edit the target. Any authenticated user can edit any other user's profile.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change errorType codes without updating all callers
